skills.name: skill-authoring
skills.summary: Create, revise, and evaluate portable skills.

skills.name: technical-planning
skills.summary: Turn complex requests into scoped, verifiable plans.

skills.name: repository-audit
requires: repository read access
shell/test tools recommended
skills.summary: Inspect a repository and report evidence-backed findings.

skills.name: debugging
requires: repository access
reproduction environment recommended
skills.summary: Diagnose, fix, and verify software defects.

skills.name: research-synthesis
requires: source access
skills.summary: Produce source-grounded research with explicit uncertainty.

skills.name: test-driven-development
requires: repository access
project test tooling or an explicitly documented verification alternative
skills.summary: Develop behavior through a verified failing test, a minimal implementation, and regression checks.

skills.name: code-review
requires: the proposed diff or changed files
repository context; tests or runtime access recommended
skills.summary: Review diffs for consequential defects and return prioritized, evidence-backed findings.

skills.name: api-design
requires: the API's consumers and use cases
service constraints and existing conventions; protocol documentation where relevant
skills.summary: Design APIs around stable contracts, explicit semantics, and safe evolution.

skills.name: database-design
requires: known entities and application use cases
read access to current schema and query patterns for existing systems
skills.summary: Model data and migrations for integrity, clear ownership, and maintainable access patterns.

skills.name: technical-documentation
requires: the actual implementation or authoritative source material
intended audience and documentation location
skills.summary: Produce accurate documentation aligned with the implemented product and its users.

skills.name: literature-review
requires: a research question or topic
access to bibliographic records and full text where available
skills.summary: Build a transparent evidence map and synthesis from traceable research sources.

skills.name: source-verification
requires: the exact claim or material to verify
access to relevant public or user-provided sources
skills.summary: Verify claims through provenance, primary evidence, cross-checks, and explicit uncertainty.

skills.name: financial-modeling
requires: the decision context and model horizon
provided inputs or clearly labeled assumptions
spreadsheet or calculation capability recommended
skills.summary: Build transparent financial scenarios with traceable assumptions and sensitivity analysis.

skills.name: financial-statement-analysis
requires: the financial statements or an authoritative public filing
reporting periods, currency, accounting basis, and company context
skills.summary: Analyze company financial statements with ratio definitions, period comparisons, and caveats.

skills.name: product-discovery
requires: the product context or initial idea
access to user evidence or a plan to collect it
skills.summary: Turn uncertain product ideas into testable user-problem and solution hypotheses.

skills.name: market-sizing
requires: the product or service definition
target geography, customer segment, time horizon, and available market evidence
skills.summary: Estimate opportunity size with explicit definitions, sourced inputs, and sensitivity ranges.

skills.name: process-mapping
requires: process owner or source description
access to interviews, documents, or operational evidence recommended
skills.summary: Map a real process, expose bottlenecks, and recommend measurable improvements.

skills.name: ux-audit
requires: a working interface, screenshots, prototype, or user-journey description
target users and key tasks; user testing or analytics recommended
skills.summary: Review real user journeys and turn observed usability issues into prioritized fixes.

skills.name: accessibility-review
requires: the interface or document under review
target platforms and applicable accessibility standard or policy; assistive technology testing recommended
skills.summary: Find accessibility barriers and propose testable fixes using applicable standards and assistive-technology context.

skills.name: design-system
requires: product goals and brand constraints
existing UI, design files, or framework conventions; component implementation access optional
skills.summary: Create a coherent, accessible, implementation-ready system of reusable design decisions.
